name: China exposure
pitch: Find portfolio holdings with exposure to China and calculate their total weight.
instructions: Start by opening the person's portfolio dashboard in a browser. When the page loads, search for any filter or tag related to geography or region. If a China or Emerging Markets filter exists, apply it. If no filter is available, read every holding row and look for a country field or tag. For each holding, check if the country is listed as China or a Chinese market. Record the weight or percentage shown for each matching holding. When all rows have been read, add the weights together to find the aggregate. If no holdings have a China tag or country, say so plainly and show an empty table. At the end, present the list of matching holdings and the total weight in a table. Never invent a weight or a country; if a weight is not shown, note that it could not be found.

examples.does: list holdings tagged China and show their combined weight

skills.name: scan-portfolio-for-region
skills.description: Read the portfolio page and identify holdings linked to China.
skills.body: 1. Navigate to the portfolio dashboard. 2. Scan the page for a geography or region filter. 3. If a filter exists, apply it and wait for results. 4. If no filter, scroll through every holding row. 5. For each row, read the country field or tag. 6. If the country is China, copy the weight shown. 7. Continue until the end of the page. 8. Add all copied weights together. 9. If no China holdings were found, note that no exposure was detected.

readme:
# china exposure
Find portfolio holdings with exposure to China and calculate their total weight.

- Needs a browser to view the portfolio dashboard.
- Will not access any account without the person's permission.
- Will not invent weights or country data; if a value is missing, it will be noted.
